title: Rabbi Acha bar Abba bar Acha
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Berakhot 25b, speaking in the name of “our master.” Hyman says, “We have already explained” in the entry R' Abba bar Acha that the reading there too should be the same.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The first-person “we have already explained” belongs to Hyman. His cross-reference to the Abba bar Acha entry is retained without assigning a canonical identity target.

The whole Davidson Berakhot 25b paragraph gives Rabbi Elazar or Rabbi Acha bar untitled Abba bar untitled Acha in Rabbeinu’s name. Rabbi Acha’s heading has local full-title support; the cross-reference uses R' Abba without transferring the son’s title to his father. Hyman’s “we have already explained/there too should read” remains his statement. Neither Rabbeinu’s identity nor an authority target for the cross-reference is admitted.
